audience.heading: The best software for freelancers in Spain
audience.description:
• No limit on invoices or expenses. 
• Keep track of Clients and Suppliers. 
• Stay on top of VAT for your clients in Spain, the EU or abroad. 
• Get predictable results, instantly.
• Download your tax forms ready to file.

models.modelo130Desc: Your fractional IRPF payment, calculated on the cumulative net income for the year.
models.modelo303Desc: Output VAT minus deductible VAT, ready every quarter with no manual reconciliation
models.retaDesc: Your Social Security contribution factored into the calculation, not as a separate surprise.
models.modelo349Desc: For your EU clients and expenses, your transactions are declared with no extra effort.

socialSecurity.heading: Nitidez and Social Security
socialSecurity.obligationsDesc: Your RETA contribution is automatically subtracted from your net income when calculating Modelo 130, no separate maths needed.
socialSecurity.bracketDesc: Based on your average net income, we show you your bracket and flag if what you're paying is running low or high.

scope.heading: What Nitidez.es is not
scope.description: We don't handle inventory, payroll or modules. Nor do we limit the number of invoices, expenses or scans you make each year.
